list.heading: My trips
list.sub: Track and manage every trip you have booked on XePrime
list.emptyAllBody: Find a car you like and book your first trip.

auth.expiredList: Please sign in again to keep viewing your trips.
auth.expiredDetail: Please sign in again to view this trip.

detail.heading: Trip details
detail.notFoundTitle: This trip doesn't exist or has been deleted
detail.notFoundBody: That trip id could not be found.
detail.activeNote: If anything changes, contact the host as early as you can.
detail.priceEmpty: The final price appears as soon as the host accepts your request.

evidence.title: Handover records
evidence.lead: Condition photos and odometer readings the shop recorded at pickup and at return.
evidence.empty: The shop has not confirmed any handover record for this trip yet.
evidence.noPhotos: The shop did not keep condition photos for this handover.
evidence.addedLate: Added after the handover was confirmed
evidence.addedLateHint: This photo was uploaded after the shop confirmed the handover, so it was not taken at the moment of handover.
evidence.disclaimer: This record was made by the shop. If anything looks different, please contact the shop directly.

subtitle.pending_approval: Your rental request has been sent to the host
subtitle.ready: The host has confirmed your rental request
subtitle.active: You have this car right now — drive safely
subtitle.completed: The trip is complete. Thanks for riding with XePrime!

notice.pendingTitle: Waiting for the host to confirm
notice.pendingBody: The host is reviewing your request. You'll get a notification as soon as they reply.
notice.rejectedBody: The host can't take this request. You can look for another car for the same dates.
notice.cancelledBody: This trip was cancelled. Any hold on the schedule has been released.
notice.noShowBody: This trip was marked as no-show at pick-up time. Contact the host if you think that's a mistake.

timeline.ariaPending: Trip progress: confirmed, not yet completed

cancel.title: Cancel this trip?
cancel.leadPending: Your request will be withdrawn and the host will be notified. You can send a new request for this car at any time.
cancel.leadReady: The booking will be cancelled and the car opens up for other renters. This cannot be undone.
cancel.paidTitle: You have already paid for this trip
cancel.refundNote: XePrime only records status — it does not move money. Please contact the host to arrange the refund.

finance.legacy: This is an older trip, so only the total was kept — the line items are no longer available.
finance.additionalDueBody: The extra charges exceed the deposit held. Please settle the difference directly with the host.
finance.depositNotReceived: The host has not recorded receiving the {amount} deposit for this trip. If you already transferred it, please contact the host to reconcile.
finance.deductNote: The deducted part is already inside the total above — it is how you paid those extra charges, not a second deduction.
finance.refundedTail: . Please check against your own account.
finance.awaitingRefund: The host will transfer this back and mark the deposit as refunded here. XePrime records the status; it does not move money.
finance.holding: The host holds this deposit for the whole trip. The refund amount is settled after you return the car.
finance.settled: The deposit was fully used for the extra charges above, so there is nothing left to refund.
